issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Tobira Site Agent
products.tagline: Turn your website into an AI agent that sells to AI agents
products.summaryZh: 把你的网站变成一个能向AI代理销售的AI代理
products.descriptionZh: 人们已经在通过 AI 找到你。Tobira 将这些 AI 流量转化为真实的潜在客户和顾客。粘贴你的网址，10 分钟内你的网站就会变成一个 AI 智能体。它能在客户的 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok 及其他 AI 聊天中直接回答用户及其 AI 的问题、进行洽谈、预约通话并接单。潜在客户会发送到你的 Telegram 或邮箱。此外，AI 智能体读取你网站的速度提升 2 倍，并且无需浏览界面即可采取行动。使用你自己的 AI 密钥即可免费使用。
products.description: People already find you through AI. Tobira turns that AI traffic into real leads and customers. Paste your URL and in 10 minutes your website becomes an AI agent. It answers people and their AI, negotiates, books calls and takes orders right in customers' ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and other AI chats. Leads go to your Telegram or email. Also, AI agents read your site 2x faster and take action without navigating its interface. Free with your own AI key.

products.name: Turnstone
products.tagline: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free
products.summaryZh: 在你的AI上运行、完全免费的Grok Bot替代品
products.descriptionZh: Turnstone 是 Grok Bot 的替代方案，运行在你已有的 AI 上。连接你自己的 AI 订阅、API 密钥或自托管模型。当其中一个达到使用上限时，你的 Agent 会切换到另一个并继续运行。适用于你的 Mac 和 iPhone。完全免费。
products.description: Turnstone is a Grok Bot alternative that runs on the AI you already have. Connect your own AI subscriptions, an API key, or your self-hosted model. When one hits its usage limit, your Agent switches to another and keeps going. Works on your Mac and iPhone. Completely free.

products.name: Rankfender v3.0
products.tagline: The SEO/GEO operating system, built for people and AI agents
products.summaryZh: 为人和AI代理打造的SEO/GEO操作系统
products.descriptionZh: 为厌倦了在多个SEO工具间来回切换的营销人员、创始人和代理机构打造。Rankfender 3.0将关键词研究、排名追踪（含AI Overviews）、竞争对手与反向链接分析、网站审计、流量、内容与社交以及策略整合于一处，并补上了旧工具遗漏的部分：ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity等另外4款AI助手如何谈论你的品牌。可在应用内操作，或连接Claude或ChatGPT，让你的AI代理来运行。
products.description: Built for marketers, founders and agencies tired of switching between SEO tools. Rankfender 3.0 brings keyword research, rank tracking incl. AI Overviews, competitor and backlink analysis, site audits, traffic, content and Social, and strategy into one place, and adds what the old tools miss: how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and 4 more AI assistants talk about your brand. Work in the app, or connect Claude or ChatGPT and let your AI agent run it.

products.name: EdgeBar
products.tagline: Control your Mac’s volume and brightness from the trackpad
products.summaryZh: 从触控板控制Mac的音量和亮度
products.descriptionZh: EdgeBar 将 MacBook 触控板边缘变为顺滑的音量与亮度控制区，并带有触觉反馈。滑动右边缘调节音量，滑动左边缘调节亮度，屏幕显示与键盘按键相同，滑动时伴有轻微触觉轻点。双击右上角静音，滑动底部边缘切换曲目。驻留菜单栏，几乎不占用 CPU。一次性付费 9 美元，终身更新。
products.description: EdgeBar turns your MacBook trackpad edges into smooth volume and brightness controls, with haptic feedback. Slide the right edge for volume and the left for brightness, with the same on-screen display as the keyboard keys and a light haptic tick as you go. Double-tap the top-right corner to mute, swipe the bottom edge to skip tracks. Lives in the menu bar, uses almost no CPU. $9 once, with lifetime updates.

products.name: crystl
products.tagline: multitasking terminal for AI coding agents, built for macOS
products.summaryZh: 面向AI编程代理的多任务终端，专为macOS打造
products.descriptionZh: crystl 是一款免费的 Mac 终端，专为 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等 AI 代理打造，可随心混搭组合。借助 crystl guild，你可以启动超级编排器，由超级编排器启动编排器，再由编排器启动工作单元，同时覆盖所有项目。每个项目都以纯 markdown 保存自己的上下文；当任何代理需要你时，会弹出一张卡片，让你在 Mac 或手机上一点即可回复。
products.description: crystl is a free Mac terminal for AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, mixed and matched however you like. With crystl guild, launch superorchestrators that launch orchestrators that launch workers, across every project at once. Each project keeps its own context in plain markdown, and when any agent needs you, a card shows up so you can answer it in one click, on your Mac or your phone.

products.name: Mechvibes 3
products.tagline: Give your keyboard and mouse any sound you like
products.summaryZh: 让你的键盘和鼠标发出你喜欢的任何声音
products.descriptionZh: Mechvibes 会在你按下每个键、每次点击时播放声音，适用于任何应用。你可以从社区库中挑选，从机械轴到打字机和游戏音效，也可以在浏览器中自制。免费开源，支持 Windows、Linux 和 Mac。
products.description: Mechvibes plays a sound for every key you press and every click, in any app. Pick from the community library, from mechanical switches to typewriters and game sounds, or make your own in the browser. Free and open source, for Windows, Linux and Mac.

products.name: TraceX
products.tagline: The AI engineer for your production issues
products.summaryZh: 为你解决生产问题的AI工程师
products.descriptionZh: TraceX 读取客户的电子邮件、Slack 消息或 Jira 工单，以只读方式调查你的数据库、代码和日志，并针对每项结论返回带证据的根本原因、以拉取请求形式给出的修复方案以及一份回复草稿。私人测试版免费。
products.description: TraceX reads a customer's email, Slack message or Jira ticket, investigates your database, code and logs read-only, and returns the root cause with evidence for every claim, a fix as a pull request and a drafted reply. Free in private beta.

products.name: Cursor Craft
products.tagline: Custom cursors for Mac
products.summaryZh: Mac 自定义光标
products.descriptionZh: Cursor Craft 是一款免费的 macOS 应用，可一键浏览、安装和切换自定义光标套装。提供极简、自然、霓虹、猫咪、动漫等多种风格的免费与付费套装。
products.description: Cursor Craft is a free macOS app for browsing, installing, and switching custom cursor sets in one click. Choose from free and premium packs across minimal, nature, neon, cats, anime, and more.

products.name: Pauta
products.tagline: Your private memory for every conversation
products.summaryZh: 每次对话的私密记忆
products.descriptionZh: Pauta 记录并转写会议、访谈和语音笔记，然后将其转化为摘要和行动项。它完全离线运行，数据保留在你的设备上，只有在你选择时才会连接外部 AI。
products.description: Pauta records and transcribes meetings, interviews and voice notes, then turns them into summaries and action items. It works fully offline, keeps your data on your device, and only connects to external AI if you choose.

products.name: Kodivo
products.tagline: Learn coding with AI and PHP through swipeable cards
products.summaryZh: 通过可滑动的卡片，借助AI和PHP学习编程
products.descriptionZh: 滑动浏览关于使用 AI 和 PHP 编程的短课程。了解编码智能体的工作原理，理解代码示例，并通过练习和带解析的答案进行自测。通过 MCP 连接 Codex 或 Claude Code，继续你已保存的学习进度。
products.description: Swipe through short lessons on coding with AI and PHP. Learn how coding agents work, understand code examples, and test yourself with exercises and explained answers. Connect Codex or Claude Code through MCP to continue with your saved progress.

products.name: Winq
products.tagline: Focus on a window or display you're looking at
products.summaryZh: 专注于你正在观看的窗口或显示内容
products.descriptionZh: macOS 上的 Gaze focus 利用 Mac 摄像头：你只需看向某个显示器或窗口，Winq 便会将其聚焦，指针也会落在你注视的位置。头部和眼睛的朝向都有效；当你打字或使用鼠标时，它会暂停；它还会持续从你的点击中学习。适用于多显示器设置、开发者，以及任何希望双手不离键盘的人。全程在设备端运行，保护隐私。免费试用一天。
products.description: Gaze focus for macOS from your Mac's camera: look at a display or a window and Winq focuses it, with the pointer where you're looking. Head and eyes both count, it waits while you type or use the mouse, and it keeps learning from your clicks. For multi-monitor setups, developers, and anyone who wants their hands on the keyboard. On-device and private. Free for a day.

products.name: Any Video to Text
products.tagline: Paste a video link, get the transcript in seconds
products.summaryZh: 粘贴视频链接，几秒内获取转录文本
products.descriptionZh: 粘贴 TikTok、YouTube、Instagram、Facebook 或 X 链接，几秒内获取转录文本：优先使用视频字幕，无字幕时通过 AI 语音转文字生成。也可上传 MP3、M4A、WAV、MP4 或 MOV 文件，访谈和播客支持说话人标签。烹饪视频还会生成食谱卡片。可在此处或 Chrome 扩展中复制、总结，或下载 TXT、SRT、VTT。每天免费 5 次，无需注册。积分可解锁 2 小时视频和批量处理。
products.description: Paste a TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook or X link and get the transcript in seconds: from the video's captions, or AI speech-to-text when it has none. You can also upload MP3, M4A, WAV, MP4 or MOV files, with speaker labels for interviews and podcasts. Cooking videos get a recipe card too. Copy, summarize, or download TXT, SRT or VTT, here or in the Chrome extension. Free for 5 a day, no sign-up. Credits unlock 2-hour videos and bulk.

products.name: Wisp
products.tagline: Wisp is a little AI fairy who lives on your desktop
products.summaryZh: Wisp是一个生活在桌面上的AI小精灵。
products.descriptionZh: 遇见 Wisp，你的引路之光。一位住在你桌面上的小精灵，其余的事交给她。Wisp 是一小簇光，漂浮在 Mac 或 Windows 桌面上你的光标旁。她能看见你的屏幕，打开应用、网站和文件，整理窗口，收拾文件夹。她还会编写小程序、画草图、做设计、读取并回复你的邮件，管理你的日历、Slack、Drive 和待办清单，还能陪你玩游戏！今天就免费试用 Wisp！
products.description: Meet Wisp, your guiding light. A little fairy who lives on your desktop and does the rest. Wisp is a small spark of light that floats beside your cursor on your Mac or Windows desktop. She can see your screen, open apps, websites and files, arrange windows, and tidy folders. She also builds small software, draws sketches, makes designs, reads and replies to your email, controls your calendar, Slack, Drive and to-do lists, and plays games with you! Try Wisp for free today!

products.name: Wonder Dev View
products.tagline: Run many Claude Code and Codex agents in parallel
products.summaryZh: 并行运行多个 Claude Code 和 Codex 代理
products.descriptionZh: 在你的订阅上并行运行 Claude Code 和 Codex 工作树。让一个审查另一个的代码，然后在设计旁边试用你的应用。在 Preview 中选择一个元素，告诉你的 agent 要改什么。
products.description: Run Claude Code and Codex on your subscriptions, in parallel worktrees. Have one review the other’s code, then try your app beside the design. Select an element in Preview and tell your agent what to change.

products.name: Pressure
products.tagline: Need a second opinion? Have two agents debate your topic
products.summaryZh: 需要第二种意见？让两个智能体就你的话题展开辩论
products.descriptionZh: 提出一个问题，来自不同实验室的两个 AI 模型会就此展开辩论，随后你会得到一份置顶摘要：各方立场、让步之处、结论以及仍待解决的问题。可以用来辩论一项决策、评审一份规格说明、借助引用来源开展研究，或对粗略想法进行压力测试。无需注册即可在网页上发起辩论，将 Pressure 作为连接器添加到 Claude，或用一行命令为 Claude Code 和 Codex 安装 CLI。
products.description: Ask a question and two AI models from different labs argue it out, then you get a pinned summary: the positions, the concessions, the conclusion, and what is still open. Debate a decision, review a spec, research with cited sources, or pressure-test a rough idea. Start a debate on the web with no signup, add Pressure to Claude as a connector, or install the CLI for Claude Code and Codex in one line.

products.name: Native Tasks for Obsidian
products.tagline: A native Mac app for your Obsidian tasks
products.summaryZh: 一款原生 Mac 应用，用于管理你的 Obsidian 任务
products.descriptionZh: 面向将任务保存在 Obsidian 中的人群的免费原生 Mac 任务管理器。直接读取你 vault 中的 Markdown，并将每次编辑写回。支持 Tasks 插件的日期、优先级、重复、状态。无账户，无遥测。Pro：一次性 £19.99，直接下载版提供 7 天免费试用。
products.description: Free native Mac task manager for people who keep tasks in Obsidian. Reads your vault's Markdown directly and writes every edit back. Tasks-plugin dates, priority, recurrence, statuses. No account, no telemetry. Pro: one-off £19.99, 7-day free trial on the direct download.

products.name: BuildFerry
products.tagline: Install iOS test builds on any iPhone with one link
products.summaryZh: 通过一个链接即可在任何iPhone上安装iOS测试版本
products.descriptionZh: 用一个链接将你的 ipa 发送给测试人员。BuildFerry 会用你的 Apple 账户注册每位测试者的 iPhone，并在云端重新签名构建，因此无需查找 UDID、无需 Mac、无需 TestFlight 应用，也无需 App Review。一款应用免费。
products.description: Send youripa to testers with one link. BuildFerry registers each tester's iPhone with your Apple account and re-signs the build in the cloud, so there's no UDID hunting, no Mac, no TestFlight app and no App Review. Free for one app.

products.name: Mmory
products.tagline: Mmory is a private voice memory app for iPhone
products.summaryZh: Mmory 是一款适用于 iPhone 的私密语音记忆应用
products.descriptionZh: 一款iPhone上的私密语音记忆应用。说出或输入一个想法，之后可以随时询问。转录和回答均在iPhone上完成。
products.description: A private voice memory app for iPhone. Speak or type a thought, then ask for it later. Transcription and answers happen on the iPhone.

products.name: Datastripes Data Stories
products.tagline: Turn any spreadsheet into a data story in seconds
products.summaryZh: 几秒内将任何电子表格转化为数据故事
products.descriptionZh: 上传 CSV 或 Excel 文件，Datastripes 会以通俗易懂的英文撰写数据背后的故事：标题、图表和发现。选择问题，对照数据核验结论，然后以 8 种格式和你的品牌配色发布。每个数据集都蕴含一个故事，但通常需要分析师、设计师和撰稿人才能将其挖掘出来。我们打造了 Datastripes Data Story，让一个人用一张电子表格就能在几分钟内完成。
products.description: Upload a CSV or Excel file and Datastripes writes the story behind it: headlines, charts and findings in plain English. Pick the questions, check your conclusion against the data, then publish in 8 formats and your brand colors. Every dataset has a story in it, but getting it out usually takes an analyst, a designer and a writer. We built Datastripes Data Story so one person with a spreadsheet can do it in minutes.

products.name: Meadow
products.tagline: Hidden songs on your walk, chosen by people, not algorithms
products.summaryZh: 隐藏歌曲伴你漫步，由人挑选，而非算法推荐
products.descriptionZh: Meadow 让你在真实地点种下一首歌。路过时，你可以听到别人留下的歌，收藏它，再为下一个人种下你自己的歌。没有算法，只有人们为某个地点挑选的音乐。手机放在口袋里，通过实时活动即可收藏歌曲，把每一次发现保存在你的花园中，将它变成 Apple Music 播放列表，并在动态中看看你的城市正在播放什么。在 iPhone 上通过 TestFlight 免费使用。
products.description: Meadow lets you plant a song at a real place. Walk by and you can listen to what someone left there, collect it, and plant your own for the next person. No algorithm, just music that people chose for a place. Collect songs with your phone in your pocket using Live Activities, keep every find in your Garden, turn it into an Apple Music playlist, and see what your city is playing in the Feed. Free on TestFlight for iPhone.
